fields.description: Issue includes the "Notebook" column by W. R. Phillips and local commentary on Florida and Dade County politics and finances, including discussion of state government and taxation. Coverage also highlights Miami and Miami Beach nightlife and entertainment venues, liquor licensing and bar trade news, and extensive sports and racing content (dog track and horse racing tips and promotions). Additional items include Miami Beach municipal election notes, transportation/causeway travel commentary, and numerous local business advertisements.
